condition: A hive-partitioned Parquet write where the partition column has both NULL and the literal string "__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__" writes both partitions to the same file path, so rows are silently lost or the file is corrupted.
workaround: Before writing, replace or reject the literal string "__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__" in partition key columns (or fill nulls with a distinct value) so that each partition gets its own path.
